title: Coefficient-norm-bounded linear functionals are currents with mass ≤ C
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, let T₀ : 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) → ℝ be ℝ-linear (TestFormOn univ k →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), and let C ∈ ℝ. Suppose that for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) and every c ∈ ℝ with |ω(x)| ≤ c for all x ∈ ℝ^N, |T₀(ω)| ≤ C·c, where |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α. Then (BC) there is T ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) (GeometricCurrentOn univ k) with T(ω) = T₀(ω) for every ω and M(T) = T.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (T₀ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |T₀ ω| ≤ C * c) → ∃ T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, (∀ ω, T ω = T₀ ω) ∧ T.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C
